text.autoconfig.grab_villager.title: Grab Villager Configuration
text.autoconfig.grab_villager.option.thr: Adjusts how far and fast the villager is thrown when charging the throw.
text.autoconfig.grab_villager.option.ena: Allows players to throw grabbed villagers instead of just dropping them.
text.autoconfig.grab_villager.option.req: If enabled, players must hold the sneak key (Shift) to pick up a villager.
